## Description and Rationale

We are Think Research Ltd, an aviation consultancy based in Bournemouth UK. We have registered for this challenge in order to showcase our analytical skills as a company, and provide a valuable opportunity to work with large datasets in aviation.

## Details

* Type: Industry
* Country: United Kingdom

library(gt)

  ~id, ~forename,          ~surname,         ~affiliation,
   1L,    "Adam", "Smith Carretero", "Think Research Ltd",
   2L,    "Levi",         "Skinner", "Think Research Ltd"
  )
) |> cols_label(id = md("**ID**"), forename = md("**Forename**"), surname ~ md("**Surname**"), affiliation ~ md("**Affiliation**"))
